title: The Unclean Spirit Returns with Seven Others
description: Jesus describes how an unclean spirit that has left a person wanders through dry places looking for rest. When it finds none, it returns to its house and finds it swept and put in order. It then takes with it seven other spirits more evil than itself, so that the person's last state becomes worse than the first. [ref:Luk 11:24-26|Luke 11:24-26]
